CustomerServiceFaqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
CustomerServiceFaqPage.subtitle: Find answers to frequently asked questions about the TNAPro system
CustomerServiceFaqPage.contactNote: If your question is not answered above, please contact our customer service team.
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq1Question: What is the TNAPro assessment system?
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq1Answer: TNAPro is a competency assessment system that helps organizations identify training needs and employee development based on competency gap analysis.
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq2Answer: You can access assessments through the dashboard after logging in with your registered account. Select the 'Assessment' menu and follow the available instructions.
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq3Question: How long does it take to complete an assessment?
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq3Answer: Assessment completion time varies depending on the number of competencies being evaluated, generally ranging from 30-60 minutes per assessment session.
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq4Question: Can I view my assessment results?
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq4Answer: Yes, assessment results can be viewed on your dashboard after the evaluation process is complete. Complete reports will be available in graphical format and detailed analysis.
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq5Question: What should I do if I forget my password?
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq5Answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your registered email, and follow the password reset instructions sent to your email.
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq6Question: Who can access my assessment results?
CustomerServiceFaqPage.faq6Answer: Assessment results can only be accessed by you, your direct supervisor, and authorized HR team members in accordance with company privacy policies.

AdminMappingTemplatePage.title: Base Mapping Template
AdminMappingTemplatePage.subtitle: Set once which competencies every position gets and at what required level, by position category. Applying the template creates and maintains those mappings; you can still change any mapping on the Competency Mapping page.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.emptyDescription: Start from a suggestion built from your current mappings (recommended), or start blank. Nothing changes until you preview and apply.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.suggestionLoaded: Suggestion loaded. Review it, then preview.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.fetchError: Failed to load the base mapping template.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.noCategoryTitle: {count, plural, one {# position has} other {# positions have}} no category
AdminMappingTemplatePage.noCategoryDescription: Rules for all positions level each position by its category. Give these positions a category, or set a default level on the rule.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.matrixDescription: One row per cluster. "All positions" and "Selected categories" create mappings; "Manual" only suggests the level when you map by hand.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.upToDate: All mappings match the saved template.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.applied: Template applied: {create} added, {updateLevel} re-levelled, {adopt} adopted, {remove} removed.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.coverageHint_NONE: Admin maps this cluster by hand, as today.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.coverageHint_ALL_POSITIONS: Every position, at the level of its category.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.coverageHint_CATEGORIES: Only positions in categories that have a level.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.coverageHint_MANUAL: Nothing is created; the level is pre-filled when you map by hand.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.problem_categoriesNeedLevel: Set a level for at least one category.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.previewDescription: This is what applying the template will do to every position right now. Mappings set by hand are never changed.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.adoptHint: Existing mappings whose level already matches the template become template mappings, so the template keeps them up to date. Mappings with a different level stay as they are.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.removeWarning: {count, plural, one {# template mapping} other {# template mappings}} will be removed because the rules no longer cover them. This includes mappings taken over from earlier data.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.noChanges: No mappings change. Applying saves the rules only.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.section_manualOverrides: mappings set by hand, kept as they are
AdminMappingTemplatePage.sectionHint_updateLevel: Template mappings whose required level changes.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.sectionHint_adopt: Same level as the template; they become template mappings.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.sectionHint_remove: The rule was removed, turned off, or no longer covers the position.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.sectionHint_manualOverrides: Their level differs from the template. Reset them on the Competency Mapping page if needed.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.sectionHint_excluded: Removed by admin earlier; the template will not re-create them.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.sectionHint_noLevel: Give them a category or set a default level.
AdminMappingTemplatePage.exclusionsDescription: Template mappings an admin removed for a position. The template will not re-create them unless you reset them.
